title: NCIS
description:
S20 E10 — Too Many Cooks
NCIS agents from Washington, D.C., Los Angeles and Hawaii, in D.C. to attend the retirement party of a beloved Federal Law Enforcement Training Center professor, find themselves investigating his shocking suicide.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E01 — Out of the Darkness
Ziva surprises Gibbs with a cryptic warning, prompting him to question why she remained underground for years while being presumed dead by family and friends.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E02 — Into the Light
With their lives in danger, Gibbs and Ziva's rogue investigation takes an unexpected turn when a possible terrorist plot is revealed.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E03 — Going Mobile
After the body of a Marine lieutenant is found hidden under an 18-wheeler, the team tracks the vehicle's previous locations to pinpoint the crime scene and suspect; Sloane encourages the team to sit down and talk about Ziva's recent reappearance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E24 — Poetic Justice
Unable to trust anyone in New Orleans, the NCIS team calls in FBI Assistant Director Isler to help expose and stop Mayor Hamilton's sinister scheme.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E17 — Treasure Hunt
The team investigates the murder of a Navy captain who was searching for a priceless 200-year-old fleur-de-lis during the annual Louisiana Pirate Festival.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E18 — Welcome to the Jungle
Pride, Sebastian and Tammy travel to South America after Pride is personally requested by a former colleague to assist with a classified operation that has been compromised.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E19 — High Stakes
Percy and LaSalle go undercover at a high-stakes poker game after the organizer targets players with access to a naval research laboratory; Laurel Pride visits her dad during spring break to discuss options after her upcoming graduation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E20 — Powder Keg
Pride and his bar patrons are held hostage by a group of volatile thieves.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E21 — Mind Games
Gregorio calls on her former behavioral science professor when the team's latest case matches one she studied during FBI training.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E22 — The Assassination of Dwayne Pride
A journalist posts a scathing article documenting Pride's "reckless use of justice"; the team is concerned about the fallout from the piece and the confidential information revealed; Rita Devereaux tells Pride it is a coordinated attack on him.

title: Law & Order
description:
S14 E20 — Everybody Loves Raimondo's
Detectives investigate a slain Hollywood producer's involvement with a mob movie to find a motive for his murder.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E09 — Criminal Law
When detectives investigate a series of seemingly random murders, they find a hit list that includes Jack McCoy; he realizes the people on the list are jurors from trial of a multiple murderer he prosecuted years ago.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E10 — Acid
When Lt. Van Buren's college friend's daughter is found dead, she leads a no-holds-barred mission to catch the serial assailant who attacked her in the past.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E17 — License to Kill
McCoy and Borgia target the unlikely hero who pursued a mass murderer through the streets of Manhattan in a deadly car chase that left one dead and one injured.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E18 — Dining Out
A celebrity chef comes under suspicion in the murder of a TV network executive when Fontana and Green learn that the two were having an affair and the chef's cooking show was about to be canceled.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E19 — Sects
While investigating a woman's murder, Fontana and Green uncover a cult that encourages sexual relations with children, and Borgia determines to put away its mesmerizing leader (Deborah Hedwall).

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E20 — Tombstone
A promiscuous lawyer ends up bludgeoned to death in her office, and detectives treat her former lovers as suspects until DNA evidence points to a co-worker.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E03 — The Brotherhood
The death of a prison gang member leads Fontana and Green to suspect the victim's former associates until they learn the deceased also had a running battle with a hard-nosed corrections officer.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E04 — Coming Down Hard
Detectives investigate the deaths of two college students and find both were participating in a pharmaceutical company's secret testing program for an antidepressant that has resulted in many suicides.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E05 — Gunplay
An illegal firearms sting backfires when two officers are slain, and Green poses as a gun buyer to try to capture the killers, who were able to identify the officers via a Website identifying undercover cops.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E06 — Cut
McCoy must determine whether charges should be filed in civil court or in criminal court when a novelist's death seems to have been caused by careless liposuction, but Branch finds a recurring pattern of negligence by the doctor.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E07 — Gov Love
McCoy takes the issue of gay marriage before the state's Supreme Court when he is unable to compel a man to testify against a crooked developer because the two say they are married.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E22 — Sport of Kings
The shooting of a Panamanian jockey sends Fontana and Falco into the colorful world of horse racing; they learn that the animal's owner used stolen funds for the purchase.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E23 — In God We Trust
Fontana and Falco make an arrest after a blaze kills a firefighter; the discovery of a charred pistol leads them to reopen the investigation into an old murder.

title: Law & Order
description:
S15 E14 — Fluency
When nine flu victims suddenly die, Green and Fontana learn that all had been injected with a fake vaccine, which leads to the arrest and prosecution of a longtime con man.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E05 — Life Line
Detectives learn that a murdered prostitute was actually an undercover reporter trying to expose a brutal gang.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E06 — Birthright
A nurse practitioner with a social agenda faces charges when an abusive young mother accused of murder suddenly dies in her jail cell; detectives learn she may have been sterilized, without knowing it.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E07 — House of Cards
A single mother is killed, and her baby is stolen; police locate the child with a woman who took the infant while pretending to be pregnant.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E08 — Codename: Ferdinand
A car crash results in the death of a photographer; Maggie sympathizes with his widow when she notices similarities with her own husband's death.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E09 — Salvation
After an altercation with a student, teacher Patrick Miller goes missing, leading the team to investigate everyone who might have had a grudge against him; a key witness in the case steps up to help.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E10 — Ties That Bind
A former kidnapping victim is linked to a series of murders that includes the daughter of an NYPD detective; Kristen begins to doubt her ability as an agent after a training exercise leaves her shaken.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E11 — Fallout
After a businessman with a history of harassment claims against him is killed, the team suspects the killer may be one of his many accusers.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E12 — Hard Decisions
A bank holdup leads the team to a safe deposit box, the contents of which have the potential to destroy national security; Kristen is eager to get back into field work while other team members still have their concerns.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E13 — Payback
The son of a retired FBI agent is kidnapped, and the team must investigate if it's an act of revenge; Isobel must make a hard call when information from the past comes to light.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E11 — Revenge
Sylvester ends up in critical condition after accidentally triggering an explosion during an investigation; the team must remain focused on finding the culprit.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E12 — Dominoes
On Christmas Eve, a boy is trapped in a beach-side cave, where the rising tide threatens his life; the team races to find a way to save him.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E13 — Kill Screen
The team tries to help Ralph when he is taken by the FBI for questioning after his web game play unintentionally reveals a CIA safe house's location.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E10 — Sins of the Father
Anthony DiNozzo Sr. (Robert Wagner) is found in a car with no memory of the previous night and a dead body in the trunk; Tony goes against orders as he tries to establish his father's innocence.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E11 — Newborn King
When a Navy captain is killed, the team must find and protect his pregnant companion; Jimmy brings his fiancée's father to work.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E12 — Housekeeping
The investigation of a Navy commander's murder leads the team to E.J. Barrett, and a second death prompts the team to protect E.J. as they hunt the killer.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E14 — Collision Course
The BAU looks into the cause of several fatal car crashes involving drivers and pedestrians; Reid gets bad news.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E15 — Alpha Male
The BAU investigates a series of disfiguring acid attacks on young men and women; Dr. Reid begins to settle into his new surroundings.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E16 — Assistance Is Futile
A mother steps forward with valuable information for the BAU to aid in their investigation of an unsub known as the bone crusher; Reid must adapt to a new set of rules in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E22 — Believer
The team questions the credibility of a former FBI agent's bizarre account.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E07 — Dust and Bones
The BAU searches for a subject who is targeting prominent members of the community.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E21 — Green Light
When Reid fears his mother has been abducted, he asks the BAU to investigate while he's stuck in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E22 — Red Light
Morgan brings the BAU new information in the case against Mr. Scratch, a serial killer and escaped convict who has been wreaking havoc on the team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E01 — Wheels Up
Agent Matt Simmons joins the BAU team in a race to take down Mr. Scratch and save one of their own in the process.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E17 — Reckoning
After a reshuffling of assignments, Pride returns to the New Orleans office during the investigation of a missing petty officer.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E19 — A House Divided
A Navy lieutenant from a well-connected and affluent family has a fatal fall down a flight of stairs at a charity gala; the team investigates whether his death was an accident or foul play.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E20 — Jackpot
When Elvis Bertrand's "daughter" is linked to a murder case, he asks Pride to prove her innocence.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E21 — Trust Me
Tammy is convinced that a con man committed the hit-and-run murder of a Navy doctor, even though the evidence shows otherwise; unbeknownst to Hannah, her husband approaches Pride with new intel on an underground spy network.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E14 — Studio Gangster
When an attorney is found dead near the body of a private escort, the team must piece together what connected the two seemingly random victims; Jubal's connection with one of the victims makes finding the killer much more personal.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E15 — Legacy
After a truck filled with armor-piercing rifles is hijacked, the team works to discover who stole it, and what they have planned for the stolen weapons; a friend from OA's past returns to help with the case, but OA isn't sure he can trust him.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E16 — Safe Room
After the police ignore a desperate father's plea for help, he abducts a billionaire's daughter and holds her hostage in a safe room until his own missing child is returned to him; Jubal puts his hostage negotiation skills to the test.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E17 — Broken Promises
When the team is called to the scene of a murder, it quickly suspects political motivation; Maggie contemplates a decision that could affect her entire career.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E18 — American Dreams
Jess LaCroix and his team come to help OA find a fugitive LaCroix arrested years ago after a bus with 26 students goes missing, and he's the main suspect.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E19 — Emotional Rescue
The team investigates a drug deal gone bad after the body of a college student is found; Detective Hailey Upton temporarily joins the team and finds her investigative methods clash with the Bureau's more buttoned-up environment.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E14 — Charades
The team searches for a CIA mole who has been coerced into stealing deadly chemicals; Paige shows Walter how to flirt.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E15 — Forget Me Nots
The team must help an injured former Secret Service agent regain his memory in order to stop the launching of weapons of mass destruction.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E16 — Love Boat
The team members go undercover on a cruise ship in order to locate and disable stolen rockets; as Valentine's Day approaches, Ralph develops a crush.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E13 — A Desperate Man
NCIS investigates the death of a Navy lieutenant whose body was found at a construction site; Ziva thinks about her future.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E14 — Life Before His Eyes
Gibbs questions the choices he has made during the course of his life when a man pulls a gun on him at a diner.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E15 — Secrets
A dead Navy captain dressed in an unusual costume underneath his uniform leads the team to discover a secret society; DiNozzo is forced to work with his ex-fiancee (Perrey Reeves).

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E11 — Full-Tilt Boogie
The BAU team's investigation into the home invasion and attempted homicide of a police chief's wife uncovers a world of secrets in a small town in Virginia.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E12 — Bad moon on the Rise
The BAU is called to New York when several casualties of a brutal nature are reported in Central Park.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E21 — Mixed Signals
The BAU is called to Taos, N.M., when someone targets victims' temporal lobes.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E08 — Ashley
The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire; Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall don't go as planned.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E15 — Annihilator
The FBI's assistant director of national security joins the BAU as it investigates the quadruple homicide of a group of roommates in St. Louis.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E08 — Neon Terror
The BAU is called in to investigate when a criminal sensationalizes his crimes by giving the local media exclusive footage.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E09 — False Flag
The BAU is called to investigate when two members of a conspiracy group in Roswell, N.M., perish in quick succession.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E10 — Submerged
When a series of backyard pool homicides are reported in California, the BAU team searches for an UnSub who has a puzzling past.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E22 — Chaos Theory
The NCIS team investigates a deadly bombing at a military museum event with over 1,000 people in attendance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E24 — The River Styx, Part II
After tracking Apollyon, a deadly underground spy network, to war-torn South Ossetia, Pride is separated from the team and faces grave danger; in order to save Pride, the NCIS team must locate a mole who continues to feed information to Apollyon.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E01 — Judgement Call
Pride must cut his vacation short when Hannah is suspended for breaking protocol during a joint investigation with the FBI.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E02 — The Terminator Conundrum
A Navy pilot says she saw an unidentified object prior to a private plane crash; Pride suffers from insomnia and nightmares as a result of being kidnapped and drugged last year.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E01 — Never Trust a Stranger
The team welcomes a new member, Special Agent Tiffany Wallace, as they search for killers who orchestrated a mass shooting at a media company; OA's personal connection with the case threatens to cloud his judgment.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E02 — Unreasonable Doubt
The team races to stop an active serial killer after three women are found weighted down at the bottom of a lake; Jubal looks into an old closed case after there are multiple similarities to the recent victims.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E03 — Liar's Poker
When the leader of a drug cartel and one of the world's most wanted men is apprehended by the team, the entire FBI headquarters is put at risk when his henchmen unveil a plot to free him; Isobel must make a difficult decision.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E04 — Crazy Love
A shooting at a quinceañera leaves two dead, but the team believes they may not have been the intended targets; Maggie is conflicted as the team decides the best plan of action for using a witness to take down their suspect.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E05 — Clean Slate
The team searches for a young girl who was kidnapped from a cabin during a family vacation; Maggie questions her relationship with Nestor when she learns he hasn't been completely honest with her.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E06 — Uncovered
The team must infiltrate a drug trafficking gang after the robbery of a chemical plant leaves two customs agents dead; Nestor offers his help on the case, giving Maggie new insight into his character.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E17 — Going South
The members of the team travel to Mexico when the daughter of a tech billionaire is abducted; Walter participates in an interview that leads to hurt feelings.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E18 — Once Bitten, Twice Die
The team must facilitate peace discussions when a conflict in Eastern Europe threatens to escalate into World War III.
